rows.name: c1_cfd_turbulent_results
rows.question: how can I see the results of the turbulent simulations?
rows.text:
To view the results of the turbulent simulations, please follow these steps:

1. Click [[point:design.tree.component.c1-cfd]]
2. Then choose Results.
3. In the Inspector, you can select the specific runs you wish to view under "Compare runs" and observe the 3D fields in the center viewport.

rows.name: c1_cfd_pathway_followup
rows.question: no, I know there's a specific pathway to see the turbulent CFD results
rows.text:
To view the turbulent CFD results for the C1-CFD component, please follow these steps:

1. Click [[point:design.tree.component.c1-cfd]]
2. Then choose Results from the expanded node.
3. In the Inspector, select the relevant run(s) under "Compare runs" and view the 3D field in the center viewport.

rows.text: To open the CFD results for C1, please click [[point:design.tree.component.c1-cfd]], then choose Results.

rows.name: c1_cfd_mesh_selected

rows.name: c1_cfd_compare_runs
rows.question: how do I compare laminar and turbulent runs?
rows.text:
To compare the laminar and turbulent runs, follow these steps:

1. Click [[point:design.field.run]] to open the Compare runs group.
2. In the Inspector, check the boxes for both the "Laminar · Re 100" and "Turbulent · Re 20622" runs.
3. Use the buttons in the CFD field slice region to toggle between the pressure ($p$) and velocity ($|U|$) fields.

rows.name: plant_turbulent_results
rows.question: how can I see the results of the turbulent CFD simulations?
rows.text:
To view the results of the turbulent CFD simulations, please follow these steps:

1. Click [[point:design.stage.cfd|7. CFD]]
2. Locate the specific CFD component row in the tree on the left.
3. Click on that component row to expand it.
4. Choose Results from the expanded nodes.

rows.name: dynamic_run_simulation
rows.question: how do I run a dynamic simulation?
rows.text:
To run a dynamic simulation, you need to complete the four steps in the Dynamic simulation section. Please follow these steps:

1. Click [[point:design.dynamic.draft]], then select your process draft.
2. Complete the "Scenario" setup.
3. Configure "Schedule & controllers" (optional).
4. Click "Run" to execute the simulation.
5. View your results in "Results & compare".
